name: QuantityBreaks
usage_hint: Tiered bulk pricing selector — list rows, image pack cards, column tiles, or compact quantity pills. Buy more, save more UI pattern with optional add-to-cart or pure-selector mode feeding PlanSelector/BuyBox.
when_to_use: For products with volume discounts (1/3/6-pack, 30/60/90-day supplies, wholesale bundles). Each tier shows quantity, price, per-unit cost, and optional savings, badge, and imagery. Use variant "cards" for image pack cards, "columns" for supply-duration tiles, "pills" for compact "how many?" selectors, or "list" for classic rows. Set emitEvents plus showCta:false to use it as a pure selector that re-prices a PlanSelector/BuyBox via the tiers:changed event.
when_not_to_use: For subscription pricing UI use PlanSelector or SubscriptionToggle. For simple quantity selectors use BuyBox. When you want separate quantity input + add button (this island combines them).
anti_patterns: Using with showCta:true alongside BuyBox on the same page (they both add to cart — set showCta:false and let BuyBox own the CTA)
Setting tier quantities that exceed available inventory without checking stock first
Listing tiers in non-ascending order (confusing — always show smallest to largest quantity)
Styling selection state via inline overrides (target [data-part="tier"][data-selected="true"] in CSS instead)

examples.label: Image pack cards with badges (pure selector for PlanSelector)
Supply-duration columns with percent-off footer strips
